# Repository artwork

`morupixel.svg` is the existing Morupixel powder-blue/navy mark.

`ocean-wave.png` is the original Morupixel artwork also used on the project website. It was generated for this project and copied without alteration. It is brand artwork, not an application screenshot or an image from upstream Compositor.

These files are for GitHub presentation. Keeping them under `.github/media` avoids adding them to the application's distribution payload.
